remarks: Updated with a Modern flair this four-bedroom home is near the water and Tod's Point, located on a quiet cul-de-sac in Old Greenwich. Spacious and bright, this home has an open design & hardwood floors. A flexible floor plan makes living and working at home easy. The first floor has a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, living room with fireplace, formal dining room, primary suite with full bath, additional bedroom and full bath. Garden level has two more bedrooms, two full baths, family room with access to stone patio, mudroom and laundry. Level and fenced backyard, perfect for entertaining, grilling and relaxing. This home is a short distance to town, schools and Metro North train. Deeded access to LI Sound at the end of the street. Perfect for today's living and enjoyment.
